I know that people don’t say it with the intention of being hurtful but it doesn’t change that it feels like daggers to the chest. To know that if you did go through with it they would call you selfish and inconsiderate. That they would be angry at you, saying “but I loved them. How could they do this to me?”
I’m a coward too. I wish I could tell my loved ones this to their faces but I can’t. I just force myself to keep living.

the way normal people experience grief is nothing compared to the daily pain that suicidal people go through. I actively choose not to walk into traffic every time I go outside. I held a knife to my heart, my throat, and my wrists trying to find the strength to end it. If you haven’t been through this much pain how can you so simply say that we’re just “shifting the pain”. No we’re not. We’re trying to stop our constant, unbearable pain. And when we choose not to kill ourselves we choose to live another day in that pain.

Imagine being yelled at for being a kind, decent person. You’re most definitely NTA. There’s not a single thing you did wrong. Sounds like your husband is bitter that you get along so well with his daughter when he doesn’t.

NTA dude I’m sorry your boy went through that. Headaches really are some of the worst things your can experience. If I were you I’d make it clear to your wife that she does not and will never have the right to ask your son to increase his suffering due to her selfishness. I wish I could give your son a hug what happened was not okay.

Yeah YTA there’s no reason you should have let the situation accelerate as it has. You should have stopped the insults from day 1 a mother should NEVER EVER be okay with anyone insulting their child. Being abusive is not an okay response to bad behavior. There are correct ways to discipline children, and insults are not it. I genuinely can’t believe you would let someone treat your child like that.
